It is in fact true and short: from the AM-GM half at x=f(t), (t+y+2c)^2 >= 4(t+c)(y+b) gives (t-y)^2 + 4(t+c)(c-b) >= 0, i.e. b-c <= (t-y)^2/(4t); swapping t and y gives the other side.
